busy.comment: kan je de progressbar uit mijn screenshot terugbrengen?
busy.reply: Your screenshot shows the meter of the intro (whole LED cells, the lit share, the ▼ mark); that one has not changed. What did change, with your Loading pick (the screen redraws), is the busy progress bar: a bar that does not know its share yet was the LED bargraph and is now the small amber glass with COMPUTING written on it. This new question shows both on the same busy bar, in the same 20 frames of 80 ms (1.6 s a cycle): option 1 the COMPUTING glass as it is now, option 2 the LED window in its bezel with the cells of your screenshot (3 px on a 6 px pitch), its lamps switching in an unordered pattern every 4 frames, no sweep. I recommend option 2: the bar keeps its bezel and window whether it knows its share or not, and the word in the package's 1 rem bar is too small to read. The bar with a share, the meter and the other waiting parts (menu entry, chart plot, skeleton, days) are the same in both options. Pick one.
